newsitem.title: FRANCE: China to make fuselage parts for Europe ATR plane.
newsitem.headline: China to make fuselage parts for Europe ATR plane.

text.p: A spokesman for the European Aero International (Regional) (AIR) marketing consortium said on Thursday that China's Xian Aircraft Company (XAC) would make rear fuselage sections for the ATR 72 turboprop plane.

The spokesman was giving details of an industrial cooperation agreement earlier announced by China's Aviation Industries of China (AVIC), during an official visit to China by French President Jacques Chirac.
Alenia Aerospazio Spa, a unit of Italy's Finmeccanica, signed the AVIC purchase, which marked a deepening of relations between Europe and China, the spokesman said.
XAC has been making wing parts for the smaller ATR 42 since a 1985 industrial agreement with ATR, the manufacturing joint venture between France's Aerospatiale and Alenia.
AIR markets the ATR 42 and 72 family, the Jetstream and Avro RJ from British Aerospace Plc.

Avic earlier signed a contract to buy five ATR 72-210A aircraft for about $80 million and took options for five more. It was the first purchase of ATRs by China and reflected development of the regional aircraft market, the spokesman said.
